purpose: Canonical, durable decision archive for product ideas explored in conversation, research, validation, hackathons, and later projects.

status_definitions.raw: Captured but not researched enough to judge.
status_definitions.validating: A narrow thesis survived research, but it must pass a cheap behavioral or payment test before implementation.
status_definitions.parked: Worth revisiting; intentionally not being pursued now.
status_definitions.passed_scope: Potentially worthwhile, but too large, slow, risky, or operationally heavy for the current hackathon.
status_definitions.passed_market: Research found the wedge crowded, blocked, weakly differentiated, or structurally unattractive.
status_definitions.needs_reconstruction: Mentioned in ideation, but the complete concept is not present in the current local notes.

ideas.name: Loop
ideas.one_liner: A finite social object for an important life moment, with an explicit audience, expected update, response contract, and a clean ending.
ideas.decision_reason: The concept survived research and was explicitly saved, but we moved on before choosing it for the hackathon.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A sharp first-use case with organic invites and a convincing reason this should be an app instead of a group chat.

ideas.name: Untitled Micro-Help Network
ideas.one_liner: A social feed where every post asks for a tiny piece of real-world judgment and every response takes about five seconds.
ideas.decision_reason: Interesting interaction primitive, but no single high-value beachhead was selected.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Find one repeatable question type with strong requester value, abundant responders, and a natural paid layer.

ideas.name: Live Roll
ideas.one_liner: Choose the frames you would keep from a photographer's contact sheet, then reveal the photographer's edit and reasoning.
ideas.decision_reason: Live client galleries are already mature; the selection-challenge wedge was more original but content supply and habit were unproven, and we chose to move on.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Secure 20 licensed rolls from respected photographers and prove repeat play with a no-code challenge.

ideas.name: Post-Loss Recovery
ideas.one_liner: Reconstruct lost household property after a disaster from existing photos, receipts, and family evidence, then produce an evidence-linked claim packet.
ideas.decision_reason: Pain and potential value are real, but trustworthy extraction, privacy, evidence review, export, and claims workflow make it too large for the remaining hackathon time.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: More runway, insurer or adjuster access, and a deliberately narrow prototype such as room-by-room photo evidence extraction.

ideas.name: Driving Rehearsal
ideas.one_liner: Rehearse a stressful route before driving by previewing lane changes, merges, difficult intersections, and the final parking approach.
ideas.decision_reason: A useful anxiety-reduction wedge exists, but navigation data quality, safety liability, and incumbent feature expansion are meaningful risks.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Prove that anxious drivers will repeatedly rehearse routes and identify a reliable data source for lane-level difficult points.

ideas.name: Primary-Source Receipts
ideas.one_liner: Trace a news claim back to the closest primary source and show the exact passage, context, and uncertainty behind it.
ideas.decision_reason: The pain is compelling, but fact-checking products already exist and reliable claim decomposition and source provenance are difficult to demonstrate honestly in a short build.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Narrow to one document-rich beat, require primary evidence, and beat generic search on citation transparency rather than declaring truth.

ideas.name: Instant Fact Check
ideas.one_liner: Type a claim or record speech live to receive a transcript, sourced checks, and citations in real time.
ideas.decision_reason: Several products already offer live or near-live claim checking, while confident errors would destroy trust in the core promise.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A defensible source corpus, visibly better latency and provenance, or a narrow professional workflow where human review is acceptable.

ideas.name: Handoff
ideas.one_liner: A marketplace-independent pickup protocol with expiring reservations, buyer queues, live deal states, safety controls, and verified handoffs.
ideas.decision_reason: Direct competitors exist, off-platform links resemble scams, and major marketplaces discourage or restrict moving transactions outside their platforms.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A direct-social or professional-seller niche where shared links are normal and automatic backup promotion clearly rescues sales.

ideas.name: Creator Portability
ideas.one_liner: Let fans follow a creator once, retain a portable relationship, and find them when they move or go live across platforms.
ideas.decision_reason: Exact alert and audience-ownership products exist, cross-platform APIs are incomplete, and the second-app cold start is severe.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A creator-controlled emergency broadcast wedge with demonstrated willingness to spend a scarce audience call-to-action on it.

ideas.name: Live-Only Social Feed
ideas.one_liner: A vertical social feed where every swipe lands on a person broadcasting live right now, with no prerecorded For You page.
ideas.decision_reason: The sentence is exceptionally clear, but TikTok already has a LIVE feed and Favorited, YouNow, BIGO-style products, and earlier live networks occupy the obvious implementation. The concept needs a new live interaction rule or community wedge before it is buildable.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Identify a format that makes ordinary people worth watching live, solves empty-feed and zero-viewer cold start, and avoids depending on virtual-gift battles or an existing creator network.

ideas.name: Screenshot Inbox
ideas.one_liner: Turn screenshots into an organized, searchable, actionable inbox instead of a forgotten camera-roll pile.
ideas.decision_reason: The utility was understandable, but the paid value and durable differentiation did not feel strong enough.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A high-frequency workflow that converts screenshots into completed actions and supports a clear subscription tier.

ideas.name: Clothing Size Translator
ideas.one_liner: Tell a shopper which size to buy at each brand using body measurements, past fit, garment data, and preferred looseness.
ideas.decision_reason: The pain is obvious, but accurate SKU-level size and fit data are the product; a superficial chart converter would not earn trust.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Obtain a reliable measurement dataset or start with one category and a small set of high-volume brands.

ideas.name: Legalese Translator
ideas.one_liner: Translate legal language into plain language and explain practical obligations, deadlines, and risks.
ideas.decision_reason: The basic translation feature is crowded and high-stakes; disclaimers do not solve the trust and unauthorized-advice boundary.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A narrow document type with deterministic extraction, source-linked explanations, and expert validation.

ideas.name: Local Coffee Discovery
ideas.one_liner: Find genuinely local coffee shops nearby using the qualities that matter to the person, not generic star rankings.
ideas.decision_reason: Captured during ideation but not deeply researched or differentiated.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Identify a discovery signal that Google Maps and Yelp do not capture, such as workability, roast style, quietness, or independent ownership.

ideas.name: Dinner Decision
ideas.one_liner: Before hunger, give the household one executable default; silence accepts it, a veto must supply a replacement or owner, and the plan locks on a deadline.
ideas.decision_reason: Passed after deep research. The broad swipe, vote, recipe, and AI dinner-decider concept is an exact 2026 competitor swarm with little visible traction. The earlier default plus accountable-veto protocol was more distinct, but not strong enough to justify a validation campaign for this hackathon.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: In a 10-14 day concierge test, require at least 70% of sessions to lock within two minutes, 50% confirmed follow-through, three uses per household per week, 40% week-two household retention, and 20% of retained households paying a real $19.99 annual founder price.

ideas.name: Focused Freelancer CRM
ideas.one_liner: A simpler client workflow for independent service businesses frustrated by HoneyBook's price, complexity, and generic process.
ideas.decision_reason: The horizontal market is crowded and switching is painful; a generic HoneyBook replacement is not a sharp enough wedge.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Choose one underserved profession with a unique job lifecycle and build around that workflow rather than around generic CRM features.

ideas.name: eBay Replacement
ideas.one_liner: A resale marketplace designed around transparent fees, competent support, scam resistance, and seller-respectful dispute handling.
ideas.decision_reason: The grievances are real, but liquidity, trust and safety, payments, disputes, shipping, and support make this a company-scale operation rather than a hackathon app.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A narrow collectible or seller vertical with its own initial supply, strong community distribution, and a materially different transaction model.

ideas.name: Resume Reuse
ideas.one_liner: Stop re-entering information already present in a resume by maintaining one verified career profile that can answer repetitive job applications.
ideas.decision_reason: Strong personal pain signal, but browser autofill and application-assistant products already occupy obvious implementations; no deep dive was completed.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Find a mobile-native or applicant-controlled standard that handles custom questions and proves every answer before submission.

ideas.name: Adult Creator Compliance
ideas.one_liner: Private identity, age-verification, consent, release, and recordkeeping workflows for independent adult creators.
ideas.decision_reason: Exact products exist, while sensitive identity storage, changing law, security, and app-store constraints create outsized risk.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A specific compliance gap validated by counsel and creators, with a storage-minimizing architecture and a viable distribution channel.

ideas.name: Medical Bill and EOB Auditor
ideas.one_liner: Compare medical bills, EOBs, codes, and benefits to flag likely errors and prepare an appeal or call script.
ideas.decision_reason: The savings pain is enormous, but the category has well-funded competitors and carries medical, financial, privacy, and data-access complexity.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A narrow bill type, partner data access, or an evidence-backed workflow that stops short of unsupported conclusions.

ideas.name: Security Deposit Evidence
ideas.one_liner: Create a time-stamped move-in and move-out evidence record that helps renters defend a security deposit.
ideas.decision_reason: The problem is real and demoable, but many exact apps exist and usage is episodic, weakening subscription economics.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Distribution through tenant groups, universities, or property partners plus a differentiated dispute packet or legal workflow.

ideas.name: School Message Organizer
ideas.one_liner: Turn scattered school emails, portals, PDFs, and texts into one reliable calendar and action list for parents.
ideas.decision_reason: Pain is widespread, but ingestion is messy, schools use fragmented systems, exact assistants are emerging, and parent willingness to pay appears limited.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A school or district channel, near-perfect extraction, and a household workflow that proves weekly retained value.

ideas.name: Co-Parenting Coordinator
ideas.one_liner: A calmer, evidence-aware co-parenting workflow for schedules, expenses, handoffs, and bounded communication.
ideas.decision_reason: There is real willingness to pay, but established court-recognized competitors, two-party adoption, safety, and evidentiary expectations raise the bar.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A one-parent utility that creates value before the other parent joins, or a sharply underserved non-court use case.

ideas.name: Family Caregiving Coordinator
ideas.one_liner: Coordinate tasks, appointments, updates, medications, and responsibility across a family caring for someone.
ideas.decision_reason: The pain is strong but exact products are numerous, multi-user onboarding is hard, and healthcare-adjacent trust requirements are high.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A single caregiver wedge that delivers immediate value from existing messages or documents before inviting the family.

ideas.name: IEP Advocate
ideas.one_liner: Help parents organize special-education records, understand process language, prepare meetings, and track promised services.
ideas.decision_reason: The need is serious, but multiple focused products are launching and bad guidance could materially harm a family.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Expert partnership, jurisdiction-specific validation, and a records-first workflow that avoids pretending to provide legal conclusions.

ideas.name: Shift Pay Checker
ideas.one_liner: Let hourly workers independently record shifts, tips, breaks, and promised rates, then compare expected pay with the paycheck.
ideas.decision_reason: The pain is concrete, but official free tools and many time/pay trackers already exist; differentiation would require a narrower worker segment.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A complex-pay niche such as tipped, piece-rate, gig, or union work where existing calculators repeatedly fail.

ideas.name: Warranty and Return Tracker
ideas.one_liner: Capture receipts and purchases automatically, then surface return, price-adjustment, and warranty deadlines before they expire.
ideas.decision_reason: The feature set is heavily copied, urgency is low between purchases, and inbox access creates a high trust burden.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Automatic measurable savings that consistently exceed the fee without requiring invasive inbox access.

ideas.name: Consumer Case Agent
ideas.one_liner: Build and pursue a documented consumer complaint across calls, chats, evidence, deadlines, and escalation channels.
ideas.decision_reason: Automated call and complaint agents are already funded and shipping; telephony, consent, reliability, and adversarial business interactions add operational weight.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A document-first escalation niche with a deterministic path and no need to impersonate the consumer on calls.

ideas.name: Quote Comparison
ideas.one_liner: Normalize confusing contractor or repair estimates, reveal missing scope, and generate apples-to-apples questions before a costly decision.
ideas.decision_reason: The savings opportunity is large, but category knowledge, local pricing, liability, and emerging exact competitors make a broad version unsafe and shallow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Commit to one trade or repair category and validate the comparison schema with practitioners and real estimates.

ideas.name: Pre-Loss Home Inventory
ideas.one_liner: Create a room-by-room inventory before a disaster for insurance and household records.
ideas.decision_reason: The category is crowded and users chronically postpone setup; the stronger unmet moment was reconstruction after a loss.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A nearly zero-effort capture method or distribution through insurers, lenders, or home services.

ideas.name: American TikTok Alternative
ideas.one_liner: A new mobile-native media format or social primitive that does not depend on short-form video or an incumbent creator platform.
ideas.decision_reason: This was the umbrella prompt that produced Loop, the micro-help network, and creator-portability research; it is too broad to build directly.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A genuinely new atomic content format with a repeatable creation-consumption loop and an initial community that can seed it.

ideas.name: Afterglow
ideas.one_liner: Concept name preserved; the full definition is not present in the current local dossiers.
ideas.decision_reason: Mentioned positively during ideation, but it cannot be scored until the original concept is reconstructed.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Recover or restate the original pitch in one paragraph.

ideas.name: PushBack
ideas.one_liner: Previously discussed app name preserved; the full definition is not present in the current local dossiers.
ideas.decision_reason: Referenced as an existing idea outside this exploration, so it should not be silently lost or reinvented.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Link its repository or restate the product thesis.

ideas.name: Instant Bank Transfer Layer
ideas.one_liner: Make moving money between bank accounts feel genuinely instant without requiring both parties to join a Venmo-style wallet.
ideas.decision_reason: The frustration is powerful, but bank rails, fraud, compliance, liquidity, and network access make this infrastructure-scale work.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A licensed partner, an overlooked RTP or FedNow workflow, and a narrowly defined transaction use case.

ideas.name: Media Card Custody
ideas.one_liner: Connect physical photo/video memory-card handoffs to machine-verifiable ingest evidence so a card is cleared under an explicit backup policy before formatting.
ideas.decision_reason: A phone QR identifies an app record or wallet slot, while an ingest report sees filenames, hashes, and mutable volume names. Without the same per-cycle nonce written onto the source card before ingest, the two records are not machine-bound. That requires a card reader ceremony, desktop helper, or ingest-vendor integration beyond the clean mobile MVP.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Reopen when a desktop helper or vendor API can write and carry a per-cycle nonce through current multi-destination reports, real fixtures prove the binding, and pressured crews sustain at least 90% transition compliance.

ideas.name: Confirmed Spoken Details
ideas.one_liner: Extract a fragile spoken date, amount, address, name, or code into a large card that the current speaker explicitly edits or confirms on the same phone.
ideas.decision_reason: Captioning is crowded, but no exact two-person confirmation ritual surfaced. The social-impact payoff is strong, yet native speech accuracy, interaction awkwardness, OS copy risk, and the need for DHH co-design prevent a build commitment.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Co-design with 8–12 Deaf or hard-of-hearing users and prove at least 90% usable token capture, sub-1.2-second median card latency, and week-two reuse before building the full product.

ideas.name: Two-Source Solar Check
ideas.one_liner: Align one supported solar-monitoring report with one utility billing window and surface an auditable energy-quantity mismatch or explain why the measurements are not comparable.
ideas.decision_reason: A second-source reconciliation gap remains, but generic bill audit is occupied and production, self-consumption, batteries, losses, and the utility meter describe different physical boundaries. Broad or dollar-based claims would be misleading.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Validate one Enphase-plus-utility pair on 20–30 real documents with more than 90% expert agreement and at least 20% real payment after the first free check.

ideas.name: Todoist Task-Debt Reset
ideas.one_liner: Guide an overwhelmed Todoist user through keep, drop, defer, and realistic short-horizon rescheduling after illness, vacation, or another life interruption.
ideas.decision_reason: Current users built their own reset scripts and the API is writable, but the trigger is episodic, value falls after the backlog is cleared, Todoist already supports bulk rescheduling, and the incumbent can copy the ceremony.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Five of ten users with a real overdue pile trust a preview and allow the app to write changes, then demonstrate repeat value beyond the first reset.

ideas.name: TipCheck
ideas.one_liner: Capture the restaurant total a diner approved and later compare it with the posted card charge.
ideas.decision_reason: The loss can be infuriating but is rare; every meal becomes an insurance ritual followed by a second manual bank check days later, and iOS cannot honestly automate settlement observation.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Across 120 real meals, retain more than 70% capture by meal four, more than 50% delayed verification, and more than 15% real prepayment.

ideas.name: BasketCheck
ideas.one_liner: Compare clipped grocery offers with the final receipt and identify a discount that failed to apply.
ideas.decision_reason: The weekly savings pain is real, but Sundria is near-exact, Kroger does not expose the useful clipped-coupon or purchase data publicly, and receipt abbreviations make reliable matching fragile.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Achieve greater than 90% line-to-offer matching across 30 real receipts without scraping or privileged retailer data.

ideas.name: Rental Toll Window
ideas.one_liner: At rental pickup, guide the traveler through the correct temporary toll-account or plate action and automatically remind them to remove it at return.
ideas.decision_reason: GoToll and neoRide already support rental vehicles and timed removal, while a jurisdiction rules directory has high maintenance and the user rents too infrequently for recurring willingness to pay.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A single airport or jurisdiction pilot proves meaningful fee prevention and profitable one-trip distribution.

ideas.name: Timer Lens
ideas.one_liner: Scan a physical appliance countdown, confirm it, and mirror it as a phone timer or Live Activity.
ideas.decision_reason: It demos well, but Siri is faster for sighted users, a laundry-specific camera timer already exists, and the strongest accessibility version depends on difficult seven-segment OCR under glare and multiplexing.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: An accessibility-first prototype achieves reliable real-device capture and users prefer it to voice/manual timer entry.

ideas.name: HoldWatch
ideas.one_liner: Track hotel, rental, restaurant, and gas-station authorization holds until the funds should be released.
ideas.decision_reason: Without bank access the app cannot observe release and becomes Notes plus Reminders; obtaining bank data adds disproportionate trust, backend, and transaction-lifecycle complexity.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A financial data partner exposes reliable pending-to-released history and frequent travelers demonstrate recurring payment willingness.

ideas.name: Spotify Playlist Time Machine
ideas.one_liner: Take nightly track-level snapshots of Spotify playlists and show exactly what disappeared or changed.
ideas.decision_reason: PlaylistHistory is exact, restoration/transfer tools are mature, and Spotify's 2026 development-mode and extended-quota rules make a new consumer product technically hostage to the platform.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A sanctioned partner path or user-controlled export source removes the quota and followed-playlist restrictions.

ideas.name: ClassPass Credit Rescue
ideas.one_liner: Warn when ClassPass credits are at risk and surface feasible ways to use them before rollover or cancellation loss.
ideas.decision_reason: ClassPass exposes neither the consumer balance nor enough personalized live pricing/inventory for an honest automatic rescue; recurring screenshots leave a thin reminder.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Consumer-authorized API access enables balance, renewal, and feasible inventory without scraping.

ideas.name: Reconnect Cable Map
ideas.one_liner: Photograph and label a cable setup before unplugging it, then walk through the connections in reverse during reassembly.
ideas.decision_reason: iCable, CableCanvas, and Dis/Assemble occupy the obvious flow; the rare consumer use loses to a phone photo and masking tape.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A professional or caregiver workflow proves repeated use and meaningful advantage over physical labels.

ideas.name: Trade-In Proof
ideas.one_liner: Guide a seller through device condition, serial, reset, packaging, weight, and shipment evidence before a mail-in trade.
ideas.decision_reason: QH8 Asset Passport and Return Proof already cover much of the workflow, and evidence does not force a platform or carrier to reverse an adverse decision.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A trade-in partner accepts the generated protocol as authoritative or a focused merchant channel distributes it.

ideas.name: Parking Evidence and Appeal
ideas.one_liner: Capture a parking session and assemble the facts needed to challenge an incorrect ticket.
ideas.decision_reason: A current exact app already uses the ParkProof name and offers ticket OCR, evidence storage, reminders, and PDF appeal; TicketPlea and WheresCar add close substitutes.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A city or parking-provider integration changes the workflow from a generic evidence packet into authoritative proof.

ideas.name: LotMatch
ideas.one_liner: Scan each tile or flooring carton before it is opened and catch a different product, dye lot, shade, or caliber before installation makes the mistake expensive.
ideas.decision_reason: No atomic installer-side carton comparator surfaced. The scan fits a natural repeated jobsite moment, exact token equality is auditable, and recent installers report costly tear-outs after mixed lots. It is the strongest fresh business candidate, but label variation and false-match risk must be beaten with real cartons.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Proceed only after at least 300 real labels across 10 brands demonstrate over 99% accepted-token accuracy, zero false matches, and crews scan over 90% of cartons on live jobs.

ideas.name: WeedCheck
ideas.one_liner: Compare a weeded heat-transfer-vinyl sheet with its source design and highlight missed material before the heat press makes the error permanent.
ideas.decision_reason: No exact consumer/mobile QA product surfaced, the failure is irreversible, and the fix-rescan loop is unusually visual for a two-minute demo. The launch must stay narrow because glossy carriers, glitter, holographic material, SVG acquisition, and camera registration can destroy reliability.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Proceed only after a blind 100-piece test reaches at least 95% recall for seeded errors over 3 mm, under 5% false holds, under 10 seconds median, and paid sellers voluntarily check most eligible orders.

ideas.name: Partial Prescription Remainder
ideas.one_liner: Track the unfilled remainder and days-left runway when a pharmacy dispenses only part of a prescription.
ideas.decision_reason: The pharmacy remains the authoritative source, prescribed total and remainder rights may not appear on the label, rules vary, and refill/runway apps already occupy the surrounding workflow. The most affected users also create the highest medical-safety and ethical-paywall risk.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A pharmacy, insurer, or prescribing-system integration supplies authoritative partial-fill and remainder state.

ideas.name: Replacement Part Pair
ideas.one_liner: Photograph an old equipment-part label and its proposed replacement, then show exact differences in selected electrical and rating fields.
ideas.decision_reason: Superseded and cross-brand replacements legitimately have different models and fields, so exact comparison creates noisy red states while semantic compatibility crosses into a risky parts-knowledge product already served by products such as Bluon PartsConnect.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A single equipment category proves a stable set of invariant fields that technicians can select before seeing the replacement, with no compatibility claim required.

ideas.name: Rekordbox USB Preflight
ideas.one_liner: Plug a DJ export drive into an iPhone and verify that referenced files decode and match a named booth profile before the gig.
ideas.decision_reason: Krate and a current Rekordbox USB tester already cover adjacency, while Rekordbox databases and analysis formats are proprietary and versioned. Header checks cannot honestly prove compatibility with a specific CDJ and firmware combination.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Licensed current parsers plus at least 20 genuine good/bad export fixtures support a named player and firmware profile with zero false greens.

ideas.name: Trailer Light Self-Test
ideas.one_liner: Mount a phone behind a trailer and let its camera and spoken sequence help one driver verify each lamp without a second person.
ideas.decision_reason: The phone-camera workaround is real and the demo is clear, but OEM test sequences and Apple Camera Remote are strong substitutes, daylight/PWM reliability is difficult, and consumer annual willingness to pay is doubtful.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A 20-trailer test exceeds 95% event sensitivity with under 2% false failures and frequent towers demonstrate repeat paid use.

ideas.name: Route-Aware Appointment Gate
ideas.one_liner: Before accepting an on-location appointment, check travel from the previous event and to the next event with setup and parking buffers.
ideas.decision_reason: Apple Calendar, OnTime, Arrively, and field-service schedulers already cover travel-time planning; missing event locations and route uncertainty make this a calendar or booking-suite feature.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A specific mobile profession shows repeated paid use despite existing calendar travel-time support and more than 95% of its event locations resolve cleanly.

ideas.name: Visual Queue Watcher
ideas.one_liner: Point a phone at a legacy queue display and receive vibration or flash when a Deaf or hard-of-hearing user's number approaches.
ideas.decision_reason: The accessibility need is real, but the phone must remain propped with its camera active, display formats vary, and the consumer willingness-to-pay ceiling is low. Venue-side queue systems are the more reliable intervention.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A clinic, bank, government office, or disability organization funds deployment after co-design validates the camera workflow.

ideas.name: Pet Food Runway
ideas.one_liner: Track an opened pet-food bag and predict when the household will run out.
ideas.decision_reason: PawLife, FurNote, Pawtion, retailer subscriptions, and connected-scale products already cover the loop; manual consumption logging is weaker than the existing substitutes.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A retailer funds cross-brand replenishment or passive measurement removes manual logging.

ideas.name: Water Softener Salt Runway
ideas.one_liner: Photograph a brine tank periodically and estimate when salt needs replenishment.
ideas.decision_reason: Opening the tank already reveals the level, photos cannot reliably detect salt bridges, and EZsalt/SoftenerIQ hardware already provides passive monitoring and alerts.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A no-hardware sensing method becomes reliable without requiring the same effort as visual inspection.

ideas.name: Campaign Snapshot Window
ideas.one_liner: Remind creators to capture expiring sponsored-content metrics and assemble the proof into a campaign report.
ideas.decision_reason: InfluenceKit, Provve, Pillar, PostRaq, and current creator CRMs already preserve analytics and produce sponsor reports; official API integrations are more durable than screenshot OCR.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A major platform removes reporting access that current products depend on while leaving a reliable share-sheet workflow open.

ideas.name: Scope Request Budget
ideas.one_liner: Share a client's requested revision into a project and show whether it consumes the agreed revision budget or needs a change order.
ideas.decision_reason: Work Scope Tracker is a near-exact low-priced iOS app, while ScopeFrame and Backstop Kit cover the broader workflow; the remaining problem is enforcing the boundary, not capturing it.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A vertical service workflow has a platform integration that can turn detection into an accepted paid change order.

ideas.name: Analog Pedal Reference Check
ideas.one_liner: Compare a transported analog pedalboard with a saved rig and highlight knobs or toggles that moved before a performance.
ideas.decision_reason: The physical camera comparison is a plausible wedge beyond PedalPlex's saved settings, but tape marks and reference photos are fast substitutes and stage-light optical accuracy is unproven.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A real-device test detects nearly all meaningful knob and toggle changes under stage lighting and musicians continue using it after four weeks.

ideas.name: Tattoo Stencil Check
ideas.one_liner: Compare a transferred tattoo stencil with its original line art and highlight missing, doubled, or broken segments before tattooing.
ideas.decision_reason: Curved skin, pose change, consented training data, artist resistance, and liability make reliable registration and trust much harder than the flat-vinyl version.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Consented fixtures demonstrate high recall with low false holds across body curvature and artists actively request the workflow.

ideas.name: Barbell Plate Symmetry
ideas.one_liner: Scan both ends of a loaded barbell and warn when the plates or total load are asymmetric before a heavy set.
ideas.decision_reason: Existing camera products recognize plates, and capturing both sides is usually more work than counting or asking a training partner; zero-false-green reliability is a difficult safety bar.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A one-pass capture reliably sees both sides and strength athletes use it on most heavy sets.

ideas.name: Embroidery Thread Gate
ideas.one_liner: At each embroidery color stop, scan the proposed thread cone and compare it with the mapped design palette before loading it.
ideas.decision_reason: Palette mapping and inconsistent spool identifiers add ceremony, while machine displays, printed palettes, and organized racks are faster substitutes for most shops.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A machine format and thread brand provide stable identifiers with a nearly automatic palette import and shops demonstrate repeat use.

ideas.name: Planar Control Reset Diff
ideas.one_liner: Capture a marked planar control panel or valve bank before service, capture it again afterward, and highlight every visual state difference without claiming the equipment is safe.
ideas.decision_reason: Generic aligned-difference apps already exist, field-service suites already require before/after photos, and the intended post-service state may legitimately differ from the pre-service state. Visual sameness cannot prove internal or safe restoration, while fiducials and two capture rituals add friction. Pool equipment-pad closeout is real pain but is better shipped inside an incumbent route workflow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A non-safety planar workflow supplies an approved reference state, not an arbitrary before image, and an incumbent field-service platform funds the comparison inside its existing closeout flow.

ideas.name: Personal Wheelchair Ride Trace
ideas.one_liner: Let a wheelchair user record repeated personal routes and compare roughness and tilt against their own prior experience without publishing a public safety map.
ideas.decision_reason: Background motion capture, phone-mount variability, and the risk that users infer safety or passability create a high technical and accessibility-validation burden for the hackathon window.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A mounted-device pilot holds measurement variation below 15%, avoids background gaps, and wheelchair-user co-design confirms the personal-comparison framing is useful and safe.

ideas.name: Multi-Chair Process Clock
ideas.one_liner: Give an independent colorist named per-chair apply, process, rinse, and tone clocks in Live Activities without making chemistry recommendations.
ideas.decision_reason: The app is straightforward, but salon formula and booking products already include timers; without evidence that concurrent chair timing is a paid standalone pain, it remains an incumbent feature.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Working colorists demonstrate frequent timer failures across multiple chairs and prefer the dedicated Live Activity flow to their existing tools.

ideas.name: CutBolt
ideas.one_liner: Before an upholstery, drapery, or custom-sewing shop makes the first cut, compare the bolt label with a confirmed job token for supplier, pattern, color, lot, and width.
ideas.decision_reason: Cut fabric is commonly nonreturnable and a wrong-bolt cut can force a full remake. No exact lightweight first-cut gate surfaced, but roll-tracking systems exist and the app must first manufacture a trusted job token, making the ritual weaker than LotMatch's physical first-carton baseline.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Interview five workrooms and proceed only if they report at least one wrong-bolt near miss per 100 jobs, required fields are consistently printed, accepted-token accuracy exceeds 99% with zero false matches, and crews scan at least 90% of first cuts.

ideas.name: LoadIn Scout
ideas.one_liner: Walk a venue's real dock-to-room load-in once, record elapsed time, steps, elevation and manual obstacles, then attach the route card to a quote or crew handoff.
ideas.decision_reason: Difficult-access fees prove that load-in friction affects quotes, and no exact measured quote primitive surfaced. However, Planning Hub and EventLab already cover venue guides and routes, indoor GPS is unusable, important facts remain manual, venues go stale, and a stopwatch plus notes is a strong substitute.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Ten event vendors complete 30 real scouts, route-card time stays within 20% of later load-ins, at least half the cards are reused in quotes, and three of ten vendors prepay about $49 per year.

ideas.name: CakeRide
ideas.one_liner: Mount a phone beside a cake or floral arrangement and record tilt and shock during delivery.
ideas.decision_reason: The primary phone must be rigidly mounted, kept awake and unavailable for navigation, while vehicle, mount and cargo differences make thresholds non-generalizable. A motion trace neither proves damage nor prevents it, and cheap shock indicators plus dedicated loggers already serve the workflow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A delivery fleet already supplies dedicated mounted devices and requests a training-only motion score with vehicle-specific calibration.

ideas.name: CoatMatch
ideas.one_liner: Before opening or pouring paint, compare the room or job baseline with the can's printed product, base, color code, and sheen.
ideas.decision_reason: Wrong-color repaint pain is real, but PaintSight already stores approved color, code, sheen and surface while PaintScan inventories labels. Printed-field equality does not prove the tint contents, and manually creating the baseline makes this an incumbent feature rather than a standalone product.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A major painting-workflow app supplies the approved job state through a share action and requests a last-inch scan gate.

ideas.name: RollGate
ideas.one_liner: Compare a queued wide-format print job with the media-roll label as the roll enters the printer.
ideas.decision_reason: The mistake can waste media, ink and time, but the trusted job state lives in the RIP while roll barcodes often contain only a vendor SKU. Printer front panels, media presets and OEM validation already mediate the workflow, so a useful product requires shop integrations and normalized inventory.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: One RIP or printer vendor exposes the queued substrate requirement and a print shop supplies a stable labeled-roll corpus for an integrated gate.

ideas.name: ResinGate
ideas.one_liner: Before resin enters a 3D-printer vat, compare the bottle with the sliced job's selected resin profile.
ideas.decision_reason: Industrial printers already scan and validate resin containers, while consumer slicer-profile acquisition and vendor-specific resin mappings make the standalone companion semantic, integration-heavy and easy for printer vendors to absorb.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A consumer printer ecosystem exposes the active sliced-job profile through a reliable local share or API while leaving bottle validation unserved.

ideas.name: RodGate
ideas.one_liner: Compare a welding procedure specification with the filler rod or spool batch before the arc starts.
ideas.decision_reason: Kemppi WeldEye already supports WPS selection and filler-batch barcode scanning. The remaining market is enterprise traceability with safety and procurement requirements, not an App Store subscription.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A welding platform or distributor requests a complementary mobile workflow outside WeldEye's coverage.

ideas.name: FormulaGate
ideas.one_liner: Before mixing hair color, compare the saved client formula with the shade tube and developer strength.
ideas.decision_reason: ColorLab Pro already scans shade and developer barcodes, while salon formula systems own the client record and mixing workflow. The last-inch check belongs inside those products.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A salon formula platform opens a job-state share action but declines to build physical tube validation.

ideas.name: FluidGate
ideas.one_liner: Before fluid is poured into a vehicle, compare the container with the intended OEM specification, viscosity, and type.
ideas.decision_reason: The phone cannot derive the intended specification without a maintained compatibility database, turning exact label comparison into a high-liability semantic recommendation already served by manufacturer fluid selectors.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A shop management system provides an authoritative required-fluid token and accepts responsibility for compatibility while the app only compares printed fields.

ideas.name: StockGate
ideas.one_liner: Before opening or loading analog film, compare the stock label with the production and camera setup.
ideas.decision_reason: FilmFridge already barcode-populates stock, ISO and format, while Flimos tracks loaded cameras and active rolls. The remaining exact pre-load gate is extremely niche and still requires a manually created production truth state.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A professional analog production demonstrates repeated wrong-stock losses and asks for the gate inside its existing stock tracker.

ideas.name: Signal Rehearsal
ideas.one_liner: Walk an event site while repeatedly probing required online endpoints and record where connectivity failed at that moment.
ideas.decision_reason: A foreground test can truthfully record historical reachability but cannot promise event-day coverage, background capture is unreliable, and Speedtest plus notes is a strong substitute. The useful version belongs inside event operations or network tooling.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A live-event operator supplies required endpoints and demonstrates that saved rehearsal traces change network or production plans repeatedly.

ideas.name: HardOut
ideas.one_liner: Run named event teardown stages against a venue's hard-out time through a Live Activity.
ideas.decision_reason: The Live Activity is easy and visually clean, but ordinary timers and existing event run sheets cover the job. It becomes a feature unless real crews prove they repeatedly need multi-stage teardown timing independent of their event software.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Ten event crews show frequent hard-out overruns attributable to timer coordination and prefer the dedicated flow to their current run sheet and alarms.

ideas.name: Sold Sweep
ideas.one_liner: After a resale item sells, run a marketplace-by-marketplace confirmation that every duplicate listing is actually gone.
ideas.decision_reason: Overselling and failed delisting are real paid pains, but Vendoo already charges for cross-listing, auto-delisting, and warnings when sold items remain live. A manual share-sheet checklist is policy-safer but materially weaker than the incumbent automation.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A meaningful cohort of high-volume sellers deliberately avoids automation yet completes at least 80% of manual sale checks and prepays about $30 per year.

ideas.name: RotaDiff
ideas.one_liner: Compare a newly posted work-roster screenshot with the last accepted version and show every changed shift before calendar import.
ideas.decision_reason: Unannounced schedule changes are common, but WorkRota already imports rota screenshots or text, exposes recognition confidence, and shows exact differences before saving. The exact product is live and already monetized through RevenueCat.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A worker vertical has a distinct scheduling artifact WorkRota cannot parse and demonstrates willingness to pay for a specialized workflow.

ideas.name: Medication Room-Temperature Clock
ideas.one_liner: Scan an insulin or GLP-1 pen and track the product-specific time remaining after it leaves refrigeration.
ideas.decision_reason: Stash Diabetes already tracks insulin and GLP-1 inventory and room-temperature expiration for free, while manufacturer limits vary by formulation and geography and a phone cannot know the actual temperature excursion. False reassurance would be medically unsafe.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A manufacturer supplies authoritative product rules and hardware-backed temperature state inside a sponsored workflow.

ideas.name: Replacement Part Vault
ideas.one_liner: Remember the exact household or equipment replacement part, filter, bulb, or consumable for the next purchase.
ideas.decision_reason: Parts & Filter Vault already covers the core exact-replacement memory for free, while barcode-memory and household-inventory apps provide adjacent substitutes. The remaining feature does not support a differentiated paid layer.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A retailer or equipment vendor provides authoritative compatibility and repeat-purchase fulfillment across a focused category.

ideas.name: Encore
ideas.one_liner: Before contracted event coverage expires, let the predesignated client or planner approve or decline one clearly priced time extension on the vendor's phone.
ideas.decision_reason: The pre-expiry decision is real and the Live Activity prototype is clean, but Mike Staff Productions already uses a carried authorization form for the exact DJ and photographer workflow, current CRMs own mobile add-ons/contracts/payments, and public evidence suggests day-of extensions are uncommon. The standalone product replaces a paper form or verbal check for a rare event, so honest pricing is a small lifetime unlock rather than a recurring subscription.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Reopen only if a coded 200–300-result pain corpus finds at least ten unique day-of authorization incidents, at least 30% of qualified vendors report an extension in their last ten events, at least 20% buy a real $19.99 lifetime unlock, and vendors activate the boundary on at least 70% of eligible events. Otherwise preserve it only as an event-CRM feature.

ideas.name: DoorHold
ideas.one_liner: When a solo mobile service provider cannot enter, start the agreed grace clock and give the absent client a no-app choice to provide access, authorize paid waiting, or accept the lockout outcome.
ideas.decision_reason: Mobile groomers and cleaners publish 10–15-minute grace periods followed by substantial fees. Jobber and Housecall Pro own on-my-way messaging and timers, but no exact independent grace-period decision card surfaced. The reachable niche may be solo providers priced out of full field-service suites, though incident frequency and SMS/link friction are existential risks.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Proceed only if 20 solo providers report at least one no-access incident per 100 appointments, providers use the flow on at least 80% of staged incidents, at least 60% of clients respond within the grace window, median response is under five minutes, and four providers prepay about $24.99.

ideas.name: CancelBy
ideas.one_liner: Bind a provider's cancellation window, fee, and cancel URL to a recurring calendar series so each moved occurrence shows exactly when money becomes non-refundable.
ideas.decision_reason: No exact cross-provider consumer app surfaced, and the money-at-risk widget is more concrete than a generic appointment alert. However, an ordinary recurring Calendar or urgent Reminder is a brutal free substitute, the app cannot confirm external cancellation, and honest monetization is a small lifetime unlock rather than a strong subscription.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Proceed only if at least 30% of 20 weekly therapy, PT, or lesson users paid a late-cancel fee in the prior year, at least half prefer the money-at-risk card over a recurring 49-hour alert, 80% configure a series in under one minute, and four prepay $14.99 lifetime.

ideas.name: BatchBaton
ideas.one_liner: Transfer active dough batches, stages, timers, and next actions to the incoming baker, who explicitly accepts the handoff.
ideas.decision_reason: The custody handoff is clearer than a generic bakery timer, but BakeOnyx, DoughFlow, Crown QMS and other bakery systems already make production stages shared team state. Cross-phone sync, food-safety expectations, kitchen phone hygiene, and shared-tablet substitutes make the standalone team app weak.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Ten two-shift microbakeries report monthly batches lost specifically at handoff and complete at least 90% of batons in a concierge pilot while rejecting their existing shared board or bakery suite.

ideas.name: Contact Sentinel
ideas.one_liner: Keep a local field-level history of contact additions, edits, merges, and deletions and selectively undo a bad change.
ideas.decision_reason: Contacts+ already provides edit, addition, deletion, merge, and per-contact restore history, while Contacts Mover previews changes and retains extensive sync histories. Local-only privacy is positioning rather than a differentiated atomic job.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Apple or current incumbents remove selective restore while a privacy-sensitive paid cohort rejects cloud contact managers.

ideas.name: Creator Rights Clock
ideas.one_liner: Track each creator deal's licensed channels, territory, and usage expiry and prompt renewal or removal action.
ideas.decision_reason: RightsTracker, RightsClock, RightsWatch and RightsOS now form an exact 2026 product swarm. The unresolved hard problem is detecting continued ad use after expiry, not storing manual deal dates.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A platform or agency integration supplies authoritative live usage state that current rights trackers cannot access.

ideas.name: Sequential Waitlist Fill
ideas.one_liner: When an appointment opens, offer it to the first waitlisted client for a limited window, then automatically move to the next until someone accepts.
ideas.decision_reason: Zenoti, Tattoo Artist Helper, Spot Squid, TattooWaitList, Appointify, WaitQ and SnapFill already implement the exact progression. Reliable delivery and booking conflict resolution also require integration with the provider's real calendar and messaging stack.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A narrow service vertical has a booking platform with no waitlist API or product and agrees to distribute an integrated solution.

ideas.name: Call-Sheet Delta Acknowledgment
ideas.one_liner: Send only changed call time, location, or instruction fields to affected crew and retain prior confirmations while collecting a one-tap re-acknowledgment.
ideas.decision_reason: SetHero, Epitome, Prod.AI, Callsheet Pro and CallSheet: Crew Calls already track delivery, live changes, versions and confirmations. The remaining product still faces roster accuracy, SMS/email delivery and production-wide adoption.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A production partner identifies a call-sheet system that cannot target changed fields and funds an integration rather than a second crew network.

ideas.name: DrawerDuo
ideas.one_liner: Have a cashier and manager independently enter drawer denominations, revealing only whether their totals reconcile before close.
ideas.decision_reason: Cash Count, RevenueRegister and modern POS systems already support blind counts, employee drawers and reconciliation. Same-phone entry does not independently verify two people and the workflow belongs inside the authoritative POS ledger.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A cash-heavy vertical lacks blind reconciliation in its POS and requests an integrated companion with authoritative opening and expected balances.

ideas.name: DwellAck
ideas.one_liner: Start a truck detention clock at arrival and ask the facility to acknowledge dock milestones before generating the claim.
ideas.decision_reason: Detention Timer, PayDwell, RigProof, HaulClaim, GetDockPay and a dense current swarm already geofence, timestamp, document and invoice detention. Facility acknowledgment adds network friction without making payment authoritative.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A shipper, broker, or carrier network agrees to accept shared milestone acknowledgments as authoritative claim evidence.

ideas.name: Runner Relay
ideas.one_liner: Move an event-runner request through open, claimed, acquired, delivered, and requester-confirmed states.
ideas.decision_reason: Zelos, CrewDash, Dispatch and festival operations systems already own temporary-crew task dispatch, while radio or text is faster than onboarding a new app for one event.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: An event organization with a stable recurring volunteer crew demonstrates task-loss pain that its current dispatch system cannot resolve.

ideas.name: ReadBack
ideas.one_liner: Have the recipient repeat a fragile spoken instruction and let the sender mark the readback correct or retry.
ideas.decision_reason: Closed-loop readback is valuable in high-stakes work, but a phone is slower than the radio or in-person protocol in its natural environments and creates safety and compliance expectations. Broad frontline voice/task products already provide accountable delivery.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A non-safety vertical proves that recorded replay and human confirmation outperform its existing radio or face-to-face procedure without requiring every temporary worker to install an app.

ideas.name: BreakLedger
ideas.one_liner: Let a worker privately timestamp offered, started, interrupted, and missed breaks for later payroll comparison.
ideas.decision_reason: LiveShift and shift-pay trackers already cover personal work and break logs. The only strong payer anticipates a wage dispute, which turns a simple timer into evidentiary and employment-law territory.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A union, worker center, or legal-aid partner sponsors a jurisdiction-specific evidence workflow and accepts its records.

ideas.name: RunSheet Pocket
ideas.one_liner: Show only one event worker's current and next run-of-show cues in a Live Activity and let them manually shift the remaining schedule when timing drifts.
ideas.decision_reason: Prelude already provides the exact Live Activity adjacency, and useful drift correction still requires someone to tap changes during the event. Without the authoritative shared run sheet it is a feature, not a standalone product.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A run-of-show platform exposes live role-filtered state but lacks a native lock-screen surface and requests an integration.

ideas.name: CuePulse
ideas.one_liner: Deliver learned haptic patterns for upcoming event or performance cues without requiring the user to look at the screen.
ideas.decision_reason: Cadence already occupies the cue-timing space, while Expo haptics cannot reliably deliver arbitrary locked, background, or Watch patterns. A missed or mislearned pocket cue is worse than a glanceable timer.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A wearable platform exposes dependable background haptic sequences and a performance cohort demonstrates lower cue error than visual timers.

ideas.name: SoundLatch
ideas.one_liner: Teach the phone one appliance beep or alarm and notify the user when it hears that sound again.
ideas.decision_reason: Apple already includes custom Sound Recognition, while a third-party version requires persistent background microphone access, creates battery and privacy costs, and risks false alerts. One-appliance scope does not support a paid standalone business.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: An accessibility partner identifies a sound class Apple's system cannot learn and funds validated background recognition with clear privacy controls.

ideas.name: PotLife Pro
ideas.one_liner: Start a Live Activity when an epoxy or composite batch is mixed and show its nominal workability and discard window.
ideas.decision_reason: Pot life changes materially with chemistry, temperature, batch mass, and container geometry, so a generic phone timer creates false precision at an irreversible moment. Manufacturer references and PourCast-type tools already provide material-specific working-time guidance.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A material manufacturer supplies an authoritative temperature- and mass-aware model and sponsors validated presets for its own products.

ideas.name: ChargeTurn
ideas.one_liner: Assign charging turns in a two-EV, one-charger household from each car's departure time and minimum range need.
ideas.decision_reason: Without authoritative state of charge and plug state, the household must maintain fragile manual data and complete a two-person handoff. Charge HQ, Wallbox, Stekker and charger/vehicle ecosystems already manage multi-EV priorities and schedules.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A charger or vehicle partner exposes reliable live state for both vehicles and lacks household priority scheduling.

ideas.name: AuctionCue
ideas.one_liner: Queue a collector's watched lots across auction houses and surface a Live Activity as each lot approaches.
ideas.decision_reason: LiveAuctioneers and auction platforms already send almost-up alerts, while there is no dependable cross-platform API for real-time lot position. Scraping a live auction creates exactly the missed-alert risk the app promises to remove.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Multiple auction houses provide sanctioned live lot-position feeds through one distribution partnership.

ideas.name: BarnBaton
ideas.one_liner: Transfer unresolved horse-care exceptions from the outgoing barn worker to an incoming worker who explicitly accepts them.
ideas.decision_reason: BarnBeacon and BarnOps already integrate shift handoff with feed, medication, treatment and records. A stripped-down second app is less trustworthy and inherits animal-safety expectations without authoritative care state.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A barn-management platform requests a focused native handoff surface inside its authoritative records.

ideas.name: TurnReady
ideas.one_liner: Let a vacation-rental cleaner mark a unit ready, an inspector accept it, and both see the guest-arrival countdown.
ideas.decision_reason: Turno, CleanTrack and Properly already own cleaner assignment, turnover status, inspections and property-team coordination. The atomic acknowledgment is an incumbent feature, not a differentiated second workflow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A property-management platform exposes turnover state but lacks explicit cleaner-to-inspector acceptance and requests an integration.

ideas.name: TapeMark
ideas.one_liner: Drop tactile chapter, highlight, or bad-take timestamps while recording audio and export the marker list afterward.
ideas.decision_reason: Markr already records, tags, exports and works offline, while professional recorders and production apps have marker workflows. The haptic button is a small interaction refinement rather than a paid wedge.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A recorder or editing platform requests a lock-screen or hardware-button marker companion with direct timeline import.

ideas.name: BufferFence
ideas.one_liner: Apply reusable preparation and wrap buffers around selected local calendar events.
ideas.decision_reason: Calendly, TIMIFY, OnTime and many scheduling products already provide event buffers, while a local-calendar companion cannot continuously reconcile all external edits. This is a calendar feature with a strong manual substitute.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A professional calendar niche demonstrates repeated buffer loss that cannot be configured in its current booking system.

ideas.name: BorrowTag
ideas.one_liner: Tap an NFC or QR tag to check a physical item out to someone and tap again on return.
ideas.decision_reason: Additem.to already supports NFC, QR, barcode lending and activity history. NFC also needs a third-party native module in Expo, while a QR fallback removes most of the interaction novelty.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A focused equipment category needs custody fields or integrations that generic lending tools cannot represent.

ideas.name: SpinBalance
ideas.one_liner: Use the phone accelerometer to compare relative appliance vibration before and after an adjustment.
ideas.decision_reason: Seismo already targets washing machines with FFT, history and export, and iPhone Measure supplies a level. Phone placement and load differences also make before-and-after vibration an unreliable diagnostic signal.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: An appliance manufacturer supplies a fixed mount and validated device-specific thresholds for a supported model family.

ideas.name: CallPromise
ideas.one_liner: Attach a promised follow-up and local notification to a contact immediately after a call.
ideas.decision_reason: iOS exposes no general call-history trigger, so the behavior stays manual. Contacts Journal and personal CRM products already track conversations and follow-ups, and Reminders is the brutal substitute.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Apple exposes a sanctioned post-call App Intent or a phone/CRM partner supplies the call event and contact context.

ideas.name: LeaveClean
ideas.one_liner: Trigger a closeout checklist when a mobile professional leaves a repeat service location.
ideas.decision_reason: Always-location permission is disproportionate for a checklist and geofence delivery is not absolute. Jobber and field-service suites already provide offline job checklists and client sharing inside the authoritative work order.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A field-service platform requests a native exit-triggered checklist using its existing job and location state.

ideas.name: RoundTable
ideas.one_liner: Pass one phone between speakers for timed agenda turns and tactile warnings.
ideas.decision_reason: Meetinged, OnlyT and generic meeting/turn timers already cover timed speakers and agendas. Passing one personal phone creates awkward group behavior without authoritative meeting state or meaningful subscription value.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A facilitated workshop format demonstrates materially better turn balance and repeat use than a visible shared timer.

ideas.name: RateReplay
ideas.one_liner: Import one utility's Green Button interval data and deterministically replay supported tariff versions to compare historical cost.
ideas.decision_reason: This rediscovered a Round-2 concept. PG&E Toolkit Pro and free utility comparators already exist, while utility-specific files, tariff versions, eligibility, tiers, demand, minimums, taxes, CCA generation, solar true-up and missing intervals make a truthful current-plan promise a maintenance business.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A utility supplies authoritative current tariffs and eligibility through a distribution partnership, and a component-limited calculator reproduces at least 20 real bills within one percent.

ideas.name: PayeeLatch
ideas.one_liner: Before a wire or ACH payment, compare a vendor's current bank token with a locally stored trusted baseline and require callback on change or unknown state.
ideas.decision_reason: Invoice-redirection pain is severe, but Vantirs, PayGurd, PaySentinel and CallbackProof already occupy the workflow. The first invoice may already be compromised, an unchanged token does not prove account ownership, and establishing the trusted baseline recreates the manual control people skip.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A bank or accounting partner supplies a verified baseline and payment-time launch point, or 70% of 20 solo owners seed and use the local check on 20 consecutive eligible payments with five real preorders.

ideas.name: FillItRight
ideas.one_liner: At rental pickup, compare prepaid fuel with self-refill from the tank level, quoted plan, and local gas price.
ideas.decision_reason: GasCap and RentRight FillItRight already provide the exact calculator for free. The expensive remaining failure is a disputed post-return fuel charge, which becomes another episodic evidence and support workflow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A rental partner supplies live contract/fuel state and a charge-dispute action unavailable in current free calculators.

ideas.name: Seller NetLock
ideas.one_liner: Reverse-calculate the minimum listing or offer price needed to preserve a reseller's target net after marketplace fees, shipping, and cost.
ideas.decision_reason: Seller Profit Calculator, FeePilot, FlipLedger and a dense commodity calculator market already exist. Fee tables require constant maintenance and the phone adds no platform-native advantage.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A marketplace exposes authoritative live fee and shipping calculations while withholding the reverse target-net workflow from sellers.

ideas.name: GroomScope
ideas.one_liner: When coat condition forces a different cut or price after drop-off, obtain an owner decision before the groomer proceeds.
ideas.decision_reason: Groomfiy already sends approve/decline price changes, while Formfy and Tuft own matting/shave waivers. A second app delays a scarce grooming table and does not resolve disputed household authority or animal-welfare judgment.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A grooming CRM requests a native conditional-consent module inside its authoritative pet, owner, service, and payment state.

ideas.name: RideOffer Net
ideas.one_liner: Include probable unpaid return miles when evaluating a rideshare offer's dollars per mile and hour.
ideas.decision_reason: Mystro, Para and Maxymo already filter offers by dollars per hour, mile, and destination. Screen/notification access is fragile and platform changes can break the product's core decision surface.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A rideshare platform exposes a sanctioned offer API and omits return-position economics from its driver tools.

ideas.name: NetworkDoubleCheck
ideas.one_liner: Before a medical visit, cross-check the provider, billing entity, NPI/TIN, facility, and insurance plan network status.
ideas.decision_reason: The consumer app lacks authoritative plan-contract, TIN and facility data; even insurer directories and staff confirmations can be wrong. A scripted call workflow cannot honestly promise verification and creates sensitive-health-data risk.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A payer supplies authoritative member-plan and billing-entity contract data with an auditable verification response.

ideas.name: SprayMix Final Tank
ideas.one_liner: Calculate ingredient and water quantities for a partial pesticide or herbicide tank from label rate, remaining volume, and area.
ideas.decision_reason: Tank Mix Calculator, SprayCalc Pro and AGSIST already provide free or cheap exact tools. Label-version maintenance, ambiguous rates and safety/liability exposure make a new standalone calculator unattractive.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A product manufacturer supplies versioned label math and validation for its own supported chemicals.

ideas.name: TowMargin
ideas.one_liner: Combine vehicle limits with actual passenger, cargo, trailer, tongue, axle, and scale weights to show the binding towing constraint.
ideas.decision_reason: Towing Limit Pro, GVWR, TowCalc, RigIQ and SteadyTow saturate the category. Estimated inputs invite unsafe conclusions and there is no differentiation without authoritative VIN data or connected scales.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A scale or vehicle partner provides authoritative live weights and ratings for a supported rig family.

ideas.name: PlugLatch
ideas.one_liner: Tap a transom NFC or QR tag after installing or removing a boat drain plug and retain the last recorded state on the phone.
ideas.decision_reason: A tap proves proximity, not plug movement, and can create catastrophic false confidence. The $12.95 PlugKeyper physically traps the ignition key with the removed plug and is a stronger battery-free forcing function.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A hardware design mechanically couples the scanned tag to actual plug position and supplies authoritative state to the app.

ideas.name: TypeLock
ideas.one_liner: At intake, have the customer enter and approve the exact engraving, monogram, or memorial inscription before production.
ideas.decision_reason: Retyping creates another transcription version, while ProofHawk, Proof Approve, Ternvia and engraving-shop systems already provide no-login mobile proofs and signed approval. Paper/POS is faster at the counter.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A shop POS requests a native same-device intake surface that writes the approved text directly into the authoritative production order.

ideas.name: BidCap
ideas.one_liner: During an auction, translate hammer price into buyer premium, tax, currency, and a private all-in ceiling.
ideas.decision_reason: BidMate and free auction calculators already provide the exact math. Manipulating a second phone while bidding is inferior to the auction platform's current bid and terms, and rate tables can change.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: An auction platform exposes sanctioned live bid and fee state but lacks a private all-in cap.

ideas.name: OTD Lock
ideas.one_liner: Keep a car buyer's out-the-door ceiling visible through each revised dealer offer and add-on.
ideas.decision_reason: A Notes number and willingness to walk are the actual behavior, purchases are years apart, and DealDrive, CharmDeal, Cartego and CarEdge already cover target-price and negotiation workflows.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A dealer marketplace exposes structured real-time worksheet state while preserving an independent consumer ceiling.

ideas.name: Allergy Readback
ideas.one_liner: Display an allergy card and ask restaurant staff to read back the stated accommodation before the diner orders.
ideas.decision_reason: A tap cannot verify kitchen process or cross-contact and may create dangerous confidence. Staff may refuse a personal phone, while allergy-card apps already exist and official guidance still requires direct conversation every time.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A restaurant system supplies authoritative ingredient and kitchen-process state and integrates the guest request into its order workflow.

ideas.name: MoveScope
ideas.one_liner: At move-day arrival, freeze the original versus revised crew, rate, scope, and total before loading begins.
ideas.decision_reason: Bad actors will refuse the workflow, honest movers already use estimates/change orders, and consumers move too rarely. The app collapses into a legal/evidence product while ChangeSnap, Contractor Ace, Ressio and e-sign tools own change approval.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A mover marketplace or regulator requires and distributes a standardized pre-loading revision flow.

ideas.name: PrintGate
ideas.one_liner: Share G-code to the phone and compare supported explicit bounds, units, nozzle, temperature, and profile tokens with a saved printer profile.
ideas.decision_reason: G-code is modal and dialect-specific, and the saved phone profile becomes stale after physical hardware changes. Firmware, slicers, GCodeInfo, AskTheNozzle and related tools own the authoritative checkpoint.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A printer/controller integration supplies current hardware state and asks for an independent preflight surface with zero false matches.

ideas.name: PrintFlight
ideas.one_liner: Share a print-ready PDF and report supported page-box, dimension, font-embedding, color-object, and output-intent facts against a preset.
ideas.decision_reason: Acrobat, PitStop/Enfocus, Fiery, RIPs and free browser tools own preflight. A phone cannot model shop stock/finishing/RIP exceptions, and incomplete PDF object parsing risks unsafe false passes.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A print shop or RIP vendor supplies its authoritative preset and a conformance corpus for a native intake companion.

ideas.name: TorqueAngle
ideas.one_liner: Rigidly mount the phone to a wrench or handle and record approximate angular rotation during a tightening step.
ideas.decision_reason: Mount slippage, drift, phone damage, device variation and safety interpretation are severe. FastenIQ already measures and logs torque-angle, and a phone cannot measure torque or certify a fastener.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A validated hardware mount and tool partner provide calibrated device-specific rotation while clearly separating torque measurement.

ideas.name: TactileBridge
ideas.one_liner: Use a tiny trained vocabulary of phone haptic patterns for basic DeafBlind communication such as yes, no, stop, and help.
ideas.decision_reason: Phone haptics can be suppressed by device state and Expo does not guarantee custom language-quality patterns. The product requires DeafBlind co-design and near-perfect distinguishability, existing apps/hardware occupy the job, and the core accessibility loop should not be paywalled.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A DeafBlind partner validates a small non-emergency vocabulary with zero misses across devices and identifies a sponsor-supported rather than consumer-subscription model.

ideas.name: CompassNest
ideas.one_liner: Sample relative phone magnetometer readings around a proposed marine-electronics installation point.
ideas.decision_reason: MagSafe, cases, phone self-field, calibration, orientation and model variance undermine thresholds. Apple describes Compass as basic assistance, while Garmin specifies a handheld compass for interference testing.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A hardware vendor validates supported phone models and mounts against an accepted reference procedure with repeatable thresholds.

ideas.name: CrashTape
ideas.one_liner: A field recorder that commits short audio segments, reconstructs a take after app termination, and never reports it verified until the output reopens successfully.
ideas.decision_reason: It is the sole Round-8 survivor because the app owns the authoritative microphone and file state and has a dramatic force-kill recovery demo. It remains only a technical spike: the likely native writer must pass a severe durability matrix, recorder willingness to pay is modest, and the differentiated custody layer must stay free.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Promote beyond validation only after 100 of 100 interruption fixtures preserve committed audio with at most two seconds of terminal loss, inaudible boundaries, no false verified state, and at least 10 of 20 field interviewers choose it as their primary recorder for two weeks.

ideas.name: AudioPin
ideas.one_liner: Keep an independent local history of Audible title, chapter, and playback offset for recovery after progress resets.
ideas.decision_reason: iOS exposes no sanctioned cross-app API for Audible playback position. Audible already owns Listen Log, Clips, and Bookmarks, while manual checkpointing cannot support automatic recovery.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Audible exposes a sanctioned read-only playback-history API with accurate title, chapter, and offset state.

ideas.name: Offline Ready
ideas.one_liner: Before leaving Wi-Fi, verify that selected books, maps, or other critical assets will actually open offline.
ideas.decision_reason: iOS sandboxing prevents a companion from inspecting another app's DRM, cache, and license state. Owning the assets would turn it into another offline reader or map product; an airplane-mode drill is the honest workaround.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Host apps expose sanctioned verifiable offline-state APIs or a platform-level offline readiness entitlement becomes available.

ideas.name: AirReady
ideas.one_liner: Before departure, verify that a travel eSIM is installed, enabled, selected for data, and configured for roaming.
ideas.decision_reason: Consumer apps cannot authoritatively read or control the installed and active carrier-plan state on iOS or Android. The result would be a checklist that loses to provider support.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Carriers or platforms expose sanctioned readback of installed plan, selected data line, activation, and roaming state.

ideas.name: ParkAbort
ideas.one_liner: Immediately before starting paid parking, confirm current plate, zone, and location with a deliberate hold gesture.
ideas.decision_reason: The companion adds a second checklist but only the parking operator can amend, cancel, or reissue a wrong session. It cannot close the financial loss after an error.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A parking network exposes cancellation or correction APIs and requests an independent pre-start confirmation surface.

ideas.name: TripClaim
ideas.one_liner: Share a forwarded confirmation or itinerary PDF, identify the traveler, and create a reliable lock-screen trip card.
ideas.decision_reason: It becomes another high-correctness itinerary parser with sensitive data. TripIt added PDF and photo import, while Flighty, Tripsy, and Wanderlog crowd the independent workflow.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A travel provider supplies structured itinerary data for trips booked by another party and lacks a traveler-claim flow.

ideas.name: ClearPair
ideas.one_liner: Find small combinations of recent YNAB transactions that mathematically explain a bank reconciliation difference.
ideas.decision_reason: Toolkit for YNAB already implemented Assisted Clear and YNAB now supports mobile reconciliation. A matching sum is not proof of which transactions posted, and new external OAuth apps begin with a 25-user cap.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: YNAB requests the feature or provides a distribution path plus authoritative posted-state information that removes ambiguity.

ideas.name: FoodTile
ideas.one_liner: Log one of a few frequent meals from a lock-screen or home-screen control and see the day's nutrition total immediately.
ideas.decision_reason: FoodNoms already provides widgets, Siri, Watch, favorites, and fast entry. Without MyFitnessPal write access, this becomes another full nutrition tracker and food database.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: A major tracker exposes sanctioned write access but does not provide a fast favorite-meal surface.

ideas.name: ShiftMirror
ideas.one_liner: Keep an independent offline shift timer and later compare it with the authoritative Jobber record.
ideas.decision_reason: A second manual clock creates a second possible discrepancy, employers need not accept it as authoritative, and mature time trackers already provide independent histories and exports.
ideas.resurrection_trigger: Employers or Jobber accept signed device records as an official correction source and workers sustain double-punch behavior.

ideas.name: LabelRelay
ideas.one_liner: Share an Amazon Seller label PDF, crop and rotate it to 4×6, preview it, and hand it to AirPrint or a thermal-printer app.
ideas.decision_reason: Label Expert already performs the exact import/crop/print loop and a large free utility swarm makes the workflow a commodity. Preview cannot guarantee carrier readability.
